name: (01) Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit) — 1 Basic — Mind Leech

system.description:
The most basic art of this path siphons a sliver of a victim's mental stamina, leaving them listless and distracted with no notion of the cause.

Make a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of the victim's Mental Traits; on a win they must bid an additional Trait on all Mental Challenges for the rest of the scene. You may successfully use Mind Leech on a given individual only once per scene, though several infernalists may each apply it to the same target. The power requires line of sight. Retest with Subterfuge.
